data.name: Spell Tamper
data.description: When a spell warrior successfully counterspells an opponent's spell, the opponent suffers a backlash of magical energy and takes 1d6 points of damage per spell level of the countered spell. If the opponent succeeds at a Will saving throw (DC %1), the damage is reduced by half. This damage is magical and is not subject to damage reduction or energy resistance.|10+floor(SkaldLVL/2)+CHA
